name: Devotion To God
overview: Scripture reveals that true devotion to God requires exclusive allegiance, as one cannot serve both God and worldly wealth (Luke 16:13). This devotion is expressed through a life surrendered as a living sacrifice, motivated by God's mercy and empowered by faith in Christ who lives within believers (Romans 12:1; Galatians 2:20). It is demonstrated in loving others as Christ loved us and in generous service that supports the weak, reflecting the blessing found in giving rather than receiving (John 13:34; Acts 20:35). God's love is the foundation for this devotion, shown supremely in the giving of His Son so that believers may have eternal life (John 3:16).
